Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing background checks on gubernatorial appointees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to background checks on gubernatorial appointees;and adding a new section to chapter 43.06 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.06 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: When requested by the governor or the director of the department ofpersonnel, nonconviction criminal history fingerprint record checksshall be conducted through the Washington state patrol identificationand criminal history section and the federal bureau of investigation onapplicants for agency head positions appointed by the governor.Information received pursuant to this section shall be confidential andmade available only to the governor or director of the department ofpersonnel or their employees directly involved in the selection,hiring, or background investigation of the subject of the record check.When necessary, applicants may be employed on a conditional basispending completion of the criminal history record check. "Agency head"as used in this section has the same definition as provided in RCW p. 1 SB 543934.05.010.
